task.instruction: Search for a vegetarian lasagna recipe that has at least a four-star rating and over 500 reviews.

final_answer:
I found a vegetarian lasagna that meets both criteria: **Artichoke Spinach Lasagna** on Allrecipes (https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/20082/artichoke-spinach-lasagna/).

- Rating: 4.6 out of 5 stars, from 1,824 ratings
- Reviews: 1,287 written reviews, which is over 500
- Time: 1 hr 20 mins total (20 mins prep, 1 hr cook), serves 8
- Ingredients: marinated artichoke hearts, spinach, mozzarella and herb-and-garlic feta, layered with tomato pasta sauce

Two other results from the search also have more than 500 ratings: Simple Spinach Lasagna (565 ratings) and Spinach Lasagna (739 ratings). I didn't open them to check their star ratings or review counts. Artichoke Spinach Lasagna is the one I confirmed meets both criteria.

judge.rationale: Final page shows Artichoke Spinach Lasagna, vegetarian description/ingredients, 4.6 rating, and 1,287 reviews, satisfying four-star and over 500 reviews.
